IUI or IVF - Which Fertility Treatment Is Right for You?

The right choice depends on your unique fertility journey. Your age, medical history, fertility diagnosis, and how long you've been trying to conceive all help determine the most suitable treatment.

In this video, our fertility expert explains the key differences between IUI and IVF, who each treatment is best suited for, and how specialists recommend the right next step based on individual needs.

Thinking about egg freezing but not sure where to start?
 Egg freezing can help preserve your fertility and provide more flexibility in planning for the future. Whether you're focusing on your career, personal goals, or waiting for the right time to start a family, understanding your options is the first step.
Our fertility experts are here to guide you through every stage of the process with personalized care and support.
📍 Book a consultation today and learn if egg freezing is right for you.

Overcoming Repeated IVF Failures With a Strategic Change
After three unsuccessful IVF cycles, a couple found success at Birla Fertility & IVF by shifting from routine treatment to a deeper, strategic approach. By accurately evaluating the root causes and selecting a genetically healthy, euploid embryo for transfer, our team helped them welcome a healthy baby girl. Repeated failure doesn't mean the end of the road; it simply means it's time to investigate further rather than repeating the same plan. If you are struggling to find answers for your fertility journey, our compassionate experts are here to provide the personalized care and advanced solutions you need.

Some fertility journeys require more than quick solutions - they require deeper investigation.
This couple came after two unsuccessful donor IUI cycles, facing challenges on both sides: poor ovarian reserve and zero sperm count.
A detailed evaluation revealed obstructive azoospermia. Through TESA, motile sperm was successfully retrieved and cryopreserved, enabling IVF with ICSI treatment planning.
The outcome: a confirmed clinical pregnancy and the birth of two healthy baby girls.
Every case has a story. The right diagnosis can make all the difference. 💕

Not every IVF challenge begins with egg quality.
A couple with a 7-year history of infertility faced an unexpected hurdle on the day of egg retrieval. While 18 mature eggs were successfully retrieved, no viable sperm was available for fertilisation.
To protect their chances of success, the clinical team acted promptly and froze the eggs. Once viable sperm was obtained from a fresh sample, fertilisation was successfully achieved using ICSI.
This case highlights an important aspect of fertility treatment: success often depends not only on advanced science, but also on timely clinical decisions and personalised care. Sometimes, preserving an opportunity today can make all the difference tomorrow.

A period is more than a monthly event—it is an important indicator of hormonal and reproductive health.

Pain that disrupts your daily life, unusually heavy bleeding, or persistently irregular cycles should not be normalised or ignored. These symptoms can sometimes signal underlying health concerns that deserve timely attention.

Access to accurate information, awareness, and medical support empowers individuals to make informed decisions about their health. At Birla Fertility & IVF, we believe that open conversations and early intervention are key to better reproductive well-being.

Extreme heat can take a toll on your health - especially if you are planning pregnancy, undergoing IVF treatment, or already pregnant.
Temperatures around 45°C may affect how the body responds during fertility treatment, and for men, prolonged heat exposure can also impact sperm count, movement, and quality. Staying hydrated, avoiding prolonged sun exposure, and taking extra precautions during peak summer conditions are important for reproductive and pregnancy health.

Birla IVF carries a strong reputation nationwide, and my experience has only reinforced my trust in that name. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Navina Singh to anyone considering fertility treatments or egg freezing.
